name: Wikipedia manual recovery
description: Correct a failed section check by opening and verifying the expected section yourself.
intro: Welcome. We will recover a failed browser check by correcting the visible page and confirming the result.

steps.title: Open Biography
steps.say: I open Biography from the article's contents and leave that section selected.

steps.title: Check for the Work section
steps.say: The check expects Work. If it fails, open Work from Wikipedia's contents, verify the heading, and choose Confirm completion.

steps.title: Read the recovered section
steps.say: I show the Work heading after verifying that the browser reached it.
